title: Severe Heatwave Dome · Indo-Gangetic Plains & Thar Desert

observation.model: IMD Pune Daily Gridded Maximum Temperature
observation.timing_note: Record temperatures exceeding 49°C were observed at Delhi, Sirsa, Churu, and Phalodi on 27-28 May.

limitations: Wet-Bulb temperature is computed at 2m height using Stull empirical psychrometric approximation.
Local urban heat island (UHI) microclimate may elevate concrete surfaces beyond the 0.25° grid mean.
